primary.title: HCL Tech Q1 results: Profit jumps 20% YoY to ₹4,626 crore; dividend declared; key takeaways from June quarter earnings
primary.summary: HCL Tech Q1 results: Profit jumped 20% YoY to ₹4,626 crore.  Sequentially, or quarter-on-quarter (QoQ), HCL Tech's profit increased by 3%. The company did not make any changes to its guidance for FY27.

related.title: HCL Tech Q1 Results: Board declares interim dividend of ₹12 per share. Details here
related.summary: HCL Technologies announced an interim dividend of ₹12 per share, marking the 94th consecutive quarter of payouts. The record date for shareholders is July 17, with the payout scheduled for July 27.

related.title: ICICI Pru AMC Q1 results: Profit jumps 23% YoY to ₹964.63 crore, revenue rises 17.5%
related.summary: ICICI Pru AMC Q1 results: ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company reported a 23% year-on-year rise in its profit to ₹964.63 crore for Q1FY27. Revenue from operations rose by 17.55% YoY to ₹1,564.22 crore.
